text: Completed GW-21 known-item/new-participant court. Added strict nested no-self-participant nuisance and item estimation, empirical-Bayes shrinkage, Transport versus three density comparators, density-residualized Transport, response-blind study transfer with training-only scale calibration, and held-out ordinal newness prediction for old and lure probes. Results: retrieval Transport CV R2 0.00704 (95% -0.01003, 0.02419); density variants negative; Transport-minus-density differences 0.0100-0.0120 with intervals crossing zero; Transport-specific CV R2 0.00215 (-0.00819, 0.01310); repeated-viewing within-study CV R2 0.070996 (0.01501, 0.13146); calibrated study-to-retrieval CV R2 0.00343 (-0.01203, 0.01888); no old/lure newness model had a positive interval. Focused density and item-effect tests pass, including oracle, permutation, zero-variance, self-mutation leakage, scale-calibration, and exact local-support checks. Trial-linked results remain in the Git-ignored local results directory.
